note: v3375: Your second eye has been reviewing diffs with the ship note cut out of them, and nothing told it. `payload_for` strips two things before the eye ever sees the code: comment-only added lines, and the `why=` ship notes in run_gates.py. Both are deliberate and both were introduced for budget. Neither was ever declared. A comment in second_eye_run.py asserted the opposite: the comment strip and the ship-note strip are deliberate and already declared The header declared THREE things - this is a diff, it is truncated, these files are absent - and neither strip. That comment stated a rule the code beside it does not implement, which is the same as not having the rule. MEASURED on v3374 raw diff of 35,350 chars: _strip_comments removed 2,049 _strip_ship_notes removed 7,885 (22% of the whole diff) Across 39 version commits: comments fired 39/39, ship notes 22/39, neither 0/39. AND IT COST A FALSE FINDING ON THE VERY NEXT LOOK v3374 came back from the cross-family eye with: "the test file claims that v3374 supplies the placement list so that panel-sourced names auto-bank; the actual banking step is not present." That is a claim-versus-delivery finding assembled out of a docstring - because the real note said the OPPOSITE, in capitals, and had been replaced by a stub: NOTHING HERE WRITES TO HIS OWNERSHIP RECORDS MEASURED in that payload: the ruling quote appears TWICE, its disclaimer ZERO times. The test file was cut at 30% from the top, and a docstring states the goal first and its limits last. The eye was asked about intent, the record of intent had been deleted in transit, and it answered from what survived. THE JOINT: v3360 built the strip. v3341 and v3349 built "the payload names what it left out". Neither knew about the other for 15 versions. WHAT SHIPPED - the header declares each strip, CONDITIONALLY and with the measured character count - `_STRIPS_APPLIED` is the roster; a third stripper with no entry is caught by the law - the map travels to the LEDGER ROW, not only the prompt. The precedent is 20 lines above the edit, written about `absent`: "the ROW must carry it too, or a later reader sees a clean verdict with no way to know its reach without rebuilding the payload by hand" - all THREE record call sites wired. v3364 records that v3363 added a parameter and wired NONE of its callers, so every row carried reach=null; that warning is in this same file ⚠ MY FIRST CUT DECLARED A STRIP THAT NEVER HAPPENED, AND MY OWN FIXTURE CAUGHT IT. `_strip_comments` ends by newline-joining the kept lines: splitlines drops the trailing newline and the join never restores it, so EVERY diff came back exactly 1 char shorter and a bare truthiness test would have declared a comment strip on every payload ever built. The delta is now taken on rstrip both sides, and a CLEAN fixture proving 0/0 is a case. ⚠ ONE RED-PROOF CAME BACK BLIND AT A CORRECT MATCH COUNT OF 1, AND THE SABOTAGE WAS THE FAULT. It edited the SECOND line of the declaration while the %d it claims to remove sits on the FIRST, so it broke something adjacent to the property and never the property. Repointed at the count itself: 10 of 10 PROVEN. HEART - "eye told what was stripped", registered in CHECKS, MINE, WATCHES and NO_JOINT_YET. It asks whether looks recorded since v3375 still carry the map, because the declaration lives in a prompt nothing keeps and the only durable trace is the row. It reads UNKNOWN today - no look since v3375 - and UNKNOWN is not OK: zero rows is an absent denominator. NO_JOINT_YET rather than COVERED_BY because a second side would re-run the same two strip functions over the same diff, which is one engine derived twice. 13 cases, 10 red-proofs PROVEN. AND IT REPAIRED FOUR LAWS THAT PINNED THE TEXT I WIDENED The full gate set came back RED with 12 gates failing. FOUR were mine, and none was a broken join - each pinned a LITERAL that a widening moved: test_a_file_can_arrive_and_still_be_unread "sha=sha, absent=absent, reach=reach)" test_partial_look_is_not_agreement that, plus the return tuple WITH its formatting test_a_ship_note_is_not_code_the_eye_must_read "_strip_ship_notes(_strip_comments(out))", and a demand that the helper appear at least THREE times - "its definition, the python diff and the html diff". Folding both diffs through ONE _prep makes the count 2 while making the strip structurally guaranteed. A law that counts CALL SITES goes red exactly when two correct sites are collapsed into one. test_the_heart_can_see_its_own_instruments followed from the three above; now reports 1,122 red-proofs declared, all well formed Each is repaired to its own stated intent and NOT weakened - the ship-note law is now BEHAVIOURAL: it hands payload_for a run_gates.py hunk carrying a note and requires the note not to survive into the prompt. Prose cannot satisfy that. 10 red-proofs re-PROVEN across the three. ⚠ A FIFTH WAS ALREADY ILL-FORMED AND IT WAS MY OWN EARLIER VERSION. test_the_vault_proposal_is_watched anchored on a bare `r.get("witnesses")` with a why claiming it occurs exactly once. MEASURED: 2 occurrences in the working tree AND 2 at HEAD - v3369 added the second in _wits(). Re-anchored on the call itself, 3 proofs PROVEN. THE OTHER SEVEN ARE NOT MINE, AND I PROVED IT BY A/B RATHER THAN BY ARGUMENT: source-window ratchet 48 with my changes IN, 48 with them OUT overlap_ratchet 2 overlaps at HEAD too, same 47 leaves test_tasks_ships fails with my changes stashed out verdict_provenance identical verdict both sides - engine_index.json, new since v3364 seal_named / frame_label / end_routes / import_bound_paths - all red in CI at 5a6e705a already ⚠ AND THE OVERLAP RATCHET IS NON-DETERMINISTIC ON IDENTICAL BYTES. Three runs of the same tree: 0 overlaps across 3 text leaves, then 2 across 47, then 0 across 3. The gate output itself says a 3-leaf heart panel is an unpopulated box and "any count here is a reading of an empty box, not a 0" - so roughly two runs in three it photographs an empty panel and PASSES. Its baseline of 0 was recorded from one of those, which means it has been comparing a real 2 against a fake 0. Carried, not silently re-baselined.
